newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares slip as investors cash in profits.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares slip as investors cash in profits.

text.p: Slovenian shares fell 0.26 percent on Monday as investors continued to cash in profits ahead of a new securities tax coming into force on January 1.
"Today and tommorow are the last days for those who want to sell ahead of the new tax so tommorow's situation may look similar," Davor Dubokovic, a trader of Eastbrokers said.
* The 10-share SBI index fell 2.99 points to 1,160.0.
* Overall five shares fell, 10 rose and five were unchanged, while five were untraded.
* Bank SKB was the most active share, falling 0.29 percent to 41,750 tolars on volume of 2,872 shares. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
